title: Saudi Arabian Kombu Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Saudi Arabia, featuring kombu and a unique blend of spices.

ingredients.name: bowl
ingredients.notes: used as a serving vessel, not an ingredient

instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the kombu and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the arabian spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice and stir to combine.
Add the rosewater (if using) and stir to combine.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional rosewater if desired.
